verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an email client, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no self-hosted deployment option. Instead, community reports describe a hosted service where all mail syncs to Shortwave's servers, and the founder says it is built on Gmail's APIs rather than IMAP, so the mail pipeline is not under the user's control.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can self-host the email app and keep the mail pipeline under my own control
